Reply with only the metric in the form {database}.{table}.{metric}. Do not wrap it in markdown fences and do not add any other text.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT dt, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM core_data.fct_transaction_variations WHERE dt BETWEEN '${start_dt}' AND '${end_dt}' AND is_ltd_product = 'false' GROUP BY dt

cases.name: find_wish_order_tracking_parcel_weight_dataset

Reply with only the table identity in the form {database}.{table}. Do not wrap it in markdown fences and do not add any other text.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT dt, COALESCE(SUM(weight), 0) AS total_weight FROM wish.master_order_tracking_infos WHERE dt BETWEEN '${start_dt}' AND '${end_dt}' GROUP BY dt

cases.expected_sql: SELECT dt, COALESCE(SUM(paid_shipping), 0) AS paid_shipping FROM wish.fact_trans_detail WHERE dt BETWEEN '${start_dt}' AND '${end_dt}' AND COALESCE(is_testing, 'false') <> 'true' GROUP BY dt
